# @qrcommunication/viva-cloud-terminal-sdk

> TypeScript SDK for the Viva Wallet Cloud Terminal API (merchant `/ecr/v1/` variant). Drive a physical EFT POS terminal from an ECR / cash register / back-office: sale, pre-auth capture, refunds (referenced, unreferenced, fast), rebate, device actions, session retrieval/abort, and outcome polling. Isomorphic (Node 18+, browser, Deno, edge, React Native), zero runtime dependencies (native `fetch`).

Viva Wallet (https://www.viva.com) is a European payments platform. This SDK wraps the merchant Cloud Terminal REST API (`https://api.vivapayments.com/ecr/v1/`, demo hosts in sandbox) with a typed, well-tested client. It is the TypeScript port of the PHP SDK `qrcommunication/viva-cloud-terminal-sdk`.

Key facts for AI agents:

- **Package**: `@qrcommunication/viva-cloud-terminal-sdk` on npm.
- **Entry point**: `.` for the client, resources, enums, errors and types.
- **Authentication**: OAuth2 `client_credentials` → Bearer token. Token endpoint `accounts.vivapayments.com/connect/token` (Basic auth), API calls `api.vivapayments.com/ecr/v1/...` (Bearer). Token cached + auto-refreshed by the SDK.
- **Amounts** are always in **cents** (number); `currencyCode` is the ISO 4217 numeric code as a string (`"978"` = EUR).
- **camelCase** on every payload.
- **Empty success bodies**: most `transactions:*` endpoints reply HTTP 200 with no body — the outcome is obtained by polling the session (`pollUntilComplete`). Each `transactions.*` method returns `{ sessionId, response }`.
- **Scope**: merchant `/ecr/v1/` only. The ISV `/ecr/isv/v1/` variant is a different SDK.

## Source map

- [src/client.ts](src/client.ts): `VivaCloudTerminalClient` — entry point + `pollUntilComplete` shortcut.
- [src/config.ts](src/config.ts): `CloudTerminalConfig` + `VivaCloudTerminalOptions` — credentials, environment, hosts, timeout, fetch.
- [src/http.ts](src/http.ts): `HttpClient` — `fetch`-based HTTP, OAuth token caching, typed error mapping.
- [src/errors.ts](src/errors.ts): `VivaError` → `ApiError`, `AuthenticationError`.
- [src/enums.ts](src/enums.ts): `Environment`, `EcrEventId` (`as const`) + helpers (`ecrEventIdFrom`, `isInProgress`, `isTerminalEvent`, `isSuccessfulEvent`, `ecrEventLabel`).
- [src/resources/](src/resources/): one file per resource (devices, transactions, sessions).
- [src/types/](src/types/): parameter and response interfaces.
- [src/uuid.ts](src/uuid.ts): `generateUuid()` (RFC 4122 v4) for session ids.
- [tests/](tests/): Vitest suite — `tests/support/mock-fetch.ts` provides an injectable `fetch` mock (`mockFetch`, `tokenResponse`).
